literal_meaning: সাপুড়ের সাপে ভয় (snake charmer's fear of his own snake)
similar_in_english: Even the bold have their fears
The expert fears his own domain
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সাধারণত সাহসী, কিন্তু এবার সাপুড়ের সাপে ভয় পেয়েছে।
যুদ্ধক্ষেত্রে সৈনিকের মতো সাহসী হলেও, নিজের পরিবারের বিষয়ে সাপুড়ের সাপে ভয় দেখায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He's usually brave, but this time he's showing the hesitation of the snake charmer fearing his own snake.
Like a soldier in battle, he's fearless, yet when it comes to family matters, he fears like the snake charmer his own snake.
note: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali rural life where snake charmers (sapure) handle venomous snakes, highlighting ironic fear in familiarity.
